name: Cuorips Inc.
summary: Cuorips Inc. engages in the research, development, manufacture, commercialization, and sale of human iPS cell-derived cardiomyocyte sheets in Japan. The company offers cellular and tissue-based, and cell processing products. It also provides contract development and manufacturing, and consulting services. The company was formerly known as Cuore Inc. and changed its name to Cuorips Inc. in June 2017. Cuorips Inc. was incorporated in 2017 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
